verdict.line: You lose if you let her walk into a clean E-engage into Q-empowered autos on open ground; you win if you fight near terrain, land E (Test of Spirit) first, and punish the 16-12s window after her Hookshot is spent.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's passive tentacles spawn on nearby impassible terrain, so every fight fought near a wall is a fight where you out-scale Camille's single-target burst with free damage and healing. Camille's entire kit depends on E (Hookshot) finding a wall to engage from and a clean auto to trigger her passive shield (Adaptive Defenses); deny either and she has no way to start the fight on her terms. That structural gap is why Illaoi holds the lane edge and the solo-kill edge here despite the series sitting at a near-even 48.1% over 642 games.

theirWindow.when: Her E is up and she's near a wall
theirWindow.what: She can Hookshot off terrain for a guaranteed knockup, then chain Q (Precision Protocol) empowered auto; from level 6 she adds R (Hextech Ultimatum) to anchor you in place for the kill. Back off walls you don't control, or have E (Test of Spirit) ready to flip the fight the moment she commits.

yourWindow.when: Right after her E or R is spent
yourWindow.what: Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12s and Ultimatum is 140/115/90s at rank 3; once either is down she has no gap closer or anchor left. Leap in with W (Harsh Lesson) and stack tentacle swings, she can't disengage.

start.why: 51.6% win rate over 442 games and the most-picked start; the extra sustain and damage let you win the level 1-5 trades where you already hold the edge.

boots.why: 49.3% win rate and 70.8% pick rate; Camille's damage comes from empowered autos (Q) and basic attacks that proc her own passive, so flat physical damage reduction blunts her whole kit.

core.why: Highest-win-rate core path (55.9% over 68 games); the armor shred amplifies every tentacle hit and ability cast on repeated engages.
The W (Harsh Lesson) proc gives you an AoE slow right when you leap in, letting you stick to a champion whose entire kit is built around repositioning.
Gives you the health buffer to survive her level 6+ Q-E-R burst window and keep fighting through it.

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-played page (42.9% pick, 49.4% win rate) and it matches the brawl-near-tentacles plan: free sustained damage and healing in the extended fights you're trying to force.

summoners.why: Highest win rate of the three common pairings (52.6%); Ignite converts your stated solo-kill advantage into actual kills before Camille's passive shield or sustain can bail her out.

playing.title: Fight near walls, not open ground
playing.detail: Your passive tentacles spawn on nearby impassible terrain, so dragging fights to jungle walls gives you free damage and healing while also removing Camille's Hookshot landing spots.

playing.title: E her before she lands an auto
playing.detail: Camille's passive (Adaptive Defenses) only shields after her own basic attack connects, so opening a trade with E (Test of Spirit) before she gets an auto off denies that shield entirely.

playing.title: Punish the post-E commit
playing.detail: Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12s; once she's used it to engage she has no escape, so follow immediately with W (Harsh Lesson) leaps and let nearby tentacles swing on her.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 burst window
playing.detail: At 6, Camille can chain Q empowered auto, E gap-close, and R (Hextech Ultimatum) anchor; don't stand near walls without E (Test of Spirit) ready to flip the fight mid-combo.

playing.title: Don't ult into her ult range
playing.detail: Her R can interrupt your tentacle formation and disengage your R's follow-up; hold Leap of Faith until after she's used Hextech Ultimatum or stay outside its 475 range while she's charging a combo.

playing.title: Farm Vessel value even off-cooldown
playing.detail: E (Test of Spirit) is only 16/15/14/13/12s; use it on cooldown near minions even when you're not all-inning, since every Vessel conversion adds tentacle pressure for the next skirmish.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Stay near terrain with tentacles when Camille closes in with (E), and brawl after using [E]. After reaching level 6, Camille can negate [R] with her (R) as well as interrupt tentacles from forming. Try not to be in range of Camille’s (R), or use [R] after Camille uses (R).
